meta.title: Privacy Policy - Soff.uz
meta.description: Privacy policy of the Soff.uz platform. About the protection of your personal information in the digital products and online services marketplace.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.p1: 1.1. This Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as "Policy") has been adopted on the Soff.uz digital products and online services marketplace platform (hereinafter referred to as "Platform") and has been developed to protect and ensure the security of users' personal information.
section1.p2: 1.2. This Policy is an integral part of the Agreement with the User and the Agreement with Sellers. By using the Platform, you agree to the terms of this Policy.

section2.title: 2. Terms and Definitions
section2.p1: Platform — Soff.uz website and mobile application, a marketplace that allows selling and buying digital products (business plans, information, manuals, abstracts, presentations, etc.) and online services.
section2.p2: Personal information — information related to a specific individual or enabling their identification.
section2.p3: User (Buyer) — a person registered as a user on the Platform for the purpose of purchasing digital products or services.
section2.p4: Seller — an individual entrepreneur, legal entity or self-employed person registered on the Platform for the purpose of selling their digital products or services.
section2.p5: Processing of personal information — any operation involving collection, storage, systematization, modification, use, transfer and destruction of personal information.

section3.title: 3. Scope of Application
section3.p1: 3.1. This Policy applies to all personal information that may be obtained from Users and/or Sellers during the process of interaction with the Platform.
section3.p2: 3.2. By using the Platform and providing personal information, the User and/or Seller consents to the processing of personal information in accordance with this Policy.

section5.title: 5. Cookies
section5.p1: 5.1. The Platform uses cookies to improve user experience and collect statistical information.
section5.p2: 5.2. The following information may be collected through cookies:
section5.cookieData4: — Information about selected products and services.
section5.p3: 5.3. Users can manage cookies by changing browser settings. However, blocking cookies may result in some Platform functions not working.

section6.title: 6. Purposes of Data Collection and Processing
section6.p1: 6.1. The Platform processes personal information for the following purposes:
section6.purpose1: — Providing access to the Platform and use of personal account;
section6.purpose2: — Processing orders for purchasing digital products and services;
section6.purpose5: — Enabling sellers to withdraw their income;
section6.purpose6: — Establishing communication with Users and Sellers;

section7.title: 7. Data Retention Period
section7.p1: 7.1. Personal information is stored for the period necessary to achieve the processing purposes.
section7.p2: 7.2. Users or Sellers have the right to withdraw their consent to the processing of personal information at any time. To do this, a written request must be sent to the email address info@soff.uz.

section8.title: 8. Data Protection Measures
section8.p1: 8.1. The Platform applies the following measures to protect personal information:
section8.measure5: — Regular security analysis of the system.
section8.p2: 8.2. Platform employees are obligated to keep users' personal information confidential.

section9.title: 9. Transfer of Information to Third Parties
section9.p1: 9.1. The Platform may transfer personal information to third parties in the following cases:
section9.transfer1: — With the consent of the User or Seller;
section9.transfer2: — For payment processing (Click, Payme and others);
section9.transfer3: — To government authorities in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan;
section9.transfer4: — To partners involved in providing Platform services.
section9.p2: 9.2. All third parties to whom information is transferred must comply with relevant data protection regulations.

section10.title: 10. User and Seller Rights
section10.userRight1: — View and modify their information in personal account;
section10.userRight3: — Obtain information about processing of their data;
section10.sellerRight1: — View and modify their information in personal account;
section10.sellerRight2: — Obtain information about processing of their data;

section11.title: 11. Policy Changes
section11.p1: 11.1. The Platform reserves the right to make changes to this Policy at any time.
section11.p2: 11.2. Changes take effect from the moment they are introduced to the Platform.
section11.p3: 11.3. By continuing to use the Platform, Users and/or Sellers confirm their consent to the changes made to the Policy.

section12.title: 12. Contact Information
section12.p1: 12.1. For questions or inquiries regarding your personal information, you can contact the following address:

section13.title: 13. Final Provisions
section13.p1: 13.1. This Policy is regulated in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
section13.p2: 13.2. Disputes related to the Policy are resolved through negotiations, and if no agreement is reached, by applying to the courts of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
